lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of circular high-luminance clusters, roughly equidistant, forming a rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of spots to form a matrix-like structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: One primary longitudinal ridge visible along the upper-mid flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated teleost fish (likely remoras) clustered near the ventral region and pectoral fin base.
